question:
The growth of online shopping will one day lead to all shops in towns and cities closing.
Do you agree or disagree with this statement?
essay:
This is more and more online shopping if here on the net which leads sharp to close in the future. I don’t hold this idea because of several reasons which I will Express here.

firstly, this idea is not true Because a majority of people would prefer to touch items at shops before purchasing them. citizens should observe Productions at shops in order to analyze the quality of them by information which are being provided by the seller. although these informations can be seen On the website,  they could be useful for the second order of that item. the second order can be done by the online shop. For example, a survey has shown that the first purchase of any products has been at shops in cities. and the following buying has been happening on the online shop. especially,  the shops which have a website  for online orders. it means that all online shops cannot be success if they don’t have any shops at towns.

in addition, the sale of productions  is high When sellers have a shop at City.  As people can confide  sellers  when they offer a warranty for items which are available at a store by signing a contract  with them. this opportunity would not be possible when residents  want to buy an item on the online shop which has not any store at the street.  such purchasing would be a genuine deterrent for people to order. thus, a shop at city cannot be replaced by online shopping. even if it offers an electronic warranty, it wouldn’t be conceivable  by purchasers.

in conclusion, I believe that online shopping can’t gain a popularity in preference to shops at cities because disadvantages of shops including the opportunity of touching a product and getting a warranty outweigh  and online shopping which won’t Have any of such benefits.
